_note: PM_RUBRIC.md §1. Base section weights + per-archetype shifts (zero-sum by design; floor 4). Harness resolves applied_weight = normalize(clamp(base+shift, floor)) to sum 100, then computes S1 = Σ(section.score × applied_weight)/100. THIS IS THE CALIBRATION TUNABLE — every change is logged in PM_RUBRIC.md changelog with the motivating golden-set case ID (GOLDEN_SET.md Runbook step 3).

a4_ai_domain_exception.note: For an A4 (Data/AI PM) JD whose DOMAIN is AI/ML itself (not merely an AI-powered product in another domain), do NOT apply the -8 domain reduction. v0.1 default is to apply it; the classifier may set ai_domain=true to suppress it.

a6_role_alignment_cap.note: PM_RUBRIC §1 A6: a product-career candidate scored against an A6 (program-heavy) JD has role_seniority capped at 60 unless the resume shows genuine ownership of product outcomes.
